process_description.description: The central process this participant continuously tries to {processing_verb}, expressed per coding style. Explain in 2-3 sentences what concrete actions reveal this process. If the segments do not allow identifying a clear process: 'Insufficient evidence.'

data_classification.description: Predominant data type. baseline: honest. properline: social desirability. interpreted: forced. vague: evasive. mixed: various.

similarity_to_previous.description: How it is SIMILAR to the previous one. If it is the first participant: 'N/A — first participant'.

difference_from_previous.description: How it DIFFERS from the previous one. If it is the first participant: 'N/A — first participant'.

needs_retry.description: true if you consider your output is incomplete, low quality, or requires additional refinement

retry_reason.description: ONLY if needs_retry=true. CONCRETE and ACTIONABLE instruction on what to improve in the next attempt. E.g.: 'Label too generic — specify distinctive properties', 'Missing evidence from segment 47', 'Definition mixes two different concepts — separate'

suggested_action.description: Recommended action: proceed (output correct, continue), retry (retry with feedback), escalate_to_hitl (human decision needed), skip (skip this agent, not relevant), abort (unrecoverable error, stop everything)
